title: MITRE T1558 Kerberoasting & Forged Kerberos Ticket Playbook

steps.activity_name: Validate Anomalous TGS Request Burst (Event ID 4769 / RC4)
steps.description: Inspect domain controller Event 4769 for RC4 (0x17) encryption downgrades across multiple SPNs.

steps.activity_name: Audit Requesting Host, Source User & Targeted Service Accounts
steps.description: Verify whether the requesting account is an authorized scanner or compromised workstation.

steps.activity_name: Hunt Subsequent Service Account Logons & Forged Ticket Anomalies
steps.description: Check Event 4624/4768 for unusual ticket lifetimes or service account lateral movement.

steps.activity_name: Isolate Source Host, Rotate Service Account Passwords / KRBTGT
steps.description: Conditional containment when unauthorized Kerberoasting or Golden/Silver Ticket use is confirmed.
steps.condition: Triggered when preliminary investigation indicators confirm active compromise or operational impact.

steps.activity_name: Document AD Hardening (gMSA/AES) & Close Kerberos Incident
steps.description: Record password rotation completion and AES-only enforcement recommendations.
